# E1.1.S1 The normal case
Feature: [E1.1](FEATURE.md) · Kind: normal (normal / awkward / failure) · Status: ○ · Last checked:

- **Who:** the kind of person, in one line (for example: a new user on a mid-range Android phone).
- **Starts from:** where they are and what is already true (signed out, list empty, offline...).
- **Does:** each step they take, one per line.
- **Sees:** exactly what should be on screen at the end, specific enough that a checker can say pass or fail
  without guessing (words shown, number of items, where they end up, how long it may take).

Last check: date, pass or fail, one line of evidence (screenshot path or what was seen).
